With a bold visual identity, the studio is known for its innovative patterns, bursting with color and energy. Elena Romero, Graphic – Textile Design - Elena Romero, Grafic - Textile Design   Home About us Collection Work Contact Elena Romero Home | Elena Romero Graphic – Textile Design I’m Elena, your print designer Specializes in stunning hand-painted floral designs and bold abstracts that bring your brand’s story to life. Based in Seville, we combine over 10 years of industry expertise with a passion for crafting bespoke patterns that reflect your brand’s unique identity. Whether you’re looking for timeless hand-painted florals or vibrant, trend-driven designs, I work with intention, creating pieces that embody the values, colors, and inspirations that define your brand. My goal is to help you connect with your audience through original prints that stand out and resonate. At Elena Romero Studio, I cherish the freedom of running my own business and the opportunity to collaborate with incredible brands that share my love for beautifully crafted designs. Each year, we produce two exclusive collections while offering custom designs for fashion, home textiles, and stationery markets worldwide. Our work is showcased at prestigious international fairs like The London Textile Fair and Première Vision , where we connect with industry leaders and present our latest creations. Register now to browse our online portfolio of ready-to-use designs in PSD or TIFF formats, pixel-perfect and in accurate repeat. Or, let’s chat about creating bespoke prints that your customers will love for seasons to come!
